headline: Sensex and Nifty pare early gains to trade lower as Brent crude nears $102 and IT stocks drag

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Brent crude prices surged towards $102 per barrel, impacting market sentiment
IT stocks dragged the indices lower despite a positive start to the trading session
Sensex witnessed a sharp 600-point reversal from its intraday high to trade in the red
Global diesel prices hit record highs as wars squeeze fuel supplies
whatHappening: Nifty 50 is trading near the 23,300 level after snapping a four-day winning streak
Maruti Suzuki is accelerating capital expenditure plans following a demand boost from GST 2.0
The NSE IPO allotment status is being finalized today after receiving 6x subscription
JM Financial has identified top NBFC picks to buy amid the current rate hike cycle
summary: Indian markets opened higher but turned negative as the Sensex dropped 600 points from its peak, with Nifty falling below 23,300. Rising Brent crude prices near $102 and weakness in IT stocks weighed on investor sentiment. Meanwhile, Maruti Suzuki announced increased capex and the NSE IPO allotment process is underway.
